tasks.title: Fix Discovery Service data structure parsing
tasks.description: Fix opencode-discovery-service.ts probeModels() to correctly parse the newSession response. The current code accesses sessionResult.models?.availableModels expecting string[], but opencode returns models as AgentModel[] directly on the session result. Map AgentModel.modelId to string for the API response.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/opencode/models returns a list of model ID strings
probeModels() correctly extracts models from newSession response
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: The newSession response from opencode has models directly on the result object, not nested under .models.availableModels. Need to trace the actual response structure and extract modelId strings.

tasks.title: Switch IssueModelSelector to useOpencodeModels hook
tasks.description: Update IssueModelSelector.tsx to use useOpencodeModels() instead of useModels(). The current hook fetches /providers/models (mohist AI SDK models) instead of /opencode/models (opencode-compatible models). Since useOpencodeModels returns string[] not Model[], adapt the component to work with string model IDs.
acceptanceCriteria: IssueModelSelector dropdown shows opencode models from /api/opencode/models
Search and selection work with string model IDs
Recent models persistence works with model ID strings
Typecheck passes
Frontend builds without errors
tasks.notes: IssueModelSelector currently uses useModels() which returns ModelProvider[]. Need to switch to useOpencodeModels() which returns string[]. The component uses Model type with id/name/badges - need to adapt to work with string model IDs.

tasks.title: Forward model via setSessionConfigOption in runAcpSession
tasks.description: In runAcpSession, destructure model from options (it IS in AcpSessionOptions but never extracted), then after connection.newSession() succeeds and before connection.prompt(), call connection.setSessionConfigOption({ scope: 'agent', option: 'model', value: model }) if model is set. Wrap in try/catch, log warn on failure but don't block the session.
acceptanceCriteria: runAcpSession extracts model from AcpSessionOptions
setSessionConfigOption is called after newSession when model is provided
setSessionConfigOption failure logs warning but doesn't abort session
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: model is already in AcpSessionOptions interface (line 52) but is never destructured or used in runAcpSession. Must add to destructuring at line ~90-104 and call setSessionConfigOption after newSession at line ~349.

tasks.title: Emit coder_session_started event with model field in runAcpSession
tasks.description: In runAcpSession, after coder_session row is created (line ~360), emit coder_session_started event via eventBus with the model field included. The event type already supports model?: string. This allows frontend to show which model was selected for the session.
acceptanceCriteria: runAcpSession emits coder_session_started event after session creation
The event includes model field when model parameter is provided
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: EventBus type already supports model?: string in coder_session_started. Need to find where eventBus.emit('coder_session_started', ...) would be called - currently only acp_session_start/completed are logged to workflow_log, not the SSE event.

tasks.title: Emit coder_session_started event with model field in createAcpConnection
tasks.description: In createAcpConnection, after coder_session row is created (line ~733), emit coder_session_started event via eventBus with the model field included. This is for multi-round sessions used in plan and review stages.
acceptanceCriteria: createAcpConnection emits coder_session_started event after session creation
The event includes model field when model parameter is provided
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Same as T-005 but for the multi-round connection path. The event should be emitted after the coderSession row is created at line ~733.
